findings.title: Dynamic evaluation of input
findings.recommendation: Remove eval/exec and explicitly parse expected data types.

findings.title: Shell command execution
findings.recommendation: Use subprocess argument arrays with shell=False and validate inputs.

findings.title: Unsafe deserialization risk
findings.recommendation: Do not unpickle untrusted data; use a constrained data format such as JSON.

findings.title: No tests provided
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for normal, error, and boundary cases.

findings.title: Missing dangerous-input regression tests
findings.recommendation: Test rejection of untrusted commands, serialized data, and expressions without executing unsafe payloads.
